name: Divine Favor
description: Your prayer empowers you with divine radiance. Until the spell ends, your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage on a hit.
effect: Your weapon gleams with divine power: +1d4 radiant damage on every weapon hit for 10 rounds (concentration).
notes: In combat (bonus action): +1d4 radiant on every weapon hit for 10 rounds. Concentration.
